title.narrative: OUTPUT 3. Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH)

description.narrative: By 2025, rights holders in 8 priority municipalities [include children in schools/ECD and families in HCFs] have access to basic and climate resilient water and sanitation services [including public spaces] are aware of best practices in hygiene and WASH facility management and living in a clean and safe environment benefitting from improved coordination and monitoring by the duty bearers.
